run_hatespeech18_preprocessing: run the HateSpeech18 module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_hatespeech18_dataset: create a HateSpeech18 classification dataset instance with hate and noHate labels
load_hatespeech18_hf_dataset: load the hate_speech18 dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
split_hatespeech18_train_test: split the hate speech dataset into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
